description: Manual seeds for projects - contains known websites and blurbs to improve search accuracy. This file is used instead of reading from input.xlsx (which is client data). Add projects here to improve search efficiency.

cheqd.blurb: Cheqd is a decentralized identity network for self-sovereign identity and verifiable credentials

MÁS.blurb: MÁS is a Spanish digital identity project for football federation

esatus.blurb: esatus provides digital identity and SSI solutions

Trusted Biz.blurb: Trusted Biz is a digital identity platform

usage.website: Optional - Known official website URL for the project. Helps prioritize and disambiguate searches.
usage.blurb: Optional - Short description about the project. Used to improve search query accuracy and context. Should be 1-2 sentences describing what the project does.
